reason: The final contract with Safran to develop the Aravalli engine secures long-term manufacturing revenue and deepens the company's technological capabilities in aerospace propulsion.
why_now: The contract was signed and announced on August 26, 2026.
source_headlines: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 26, 2026, titled "HAL and SafranHelicopter Engines sign final contract with SAFHAL, launchingdevelopment and production of the Aravalli engine".
